description: The main window reads and writes the .utl file that the user picks in a native dialog, and writes the .bak backup next to it. The dialog plugin adds the picked path to the fs scope (permission-dialog-2.8.3/src/commands.rs 188-215, 248-258), so no folder scope is needed for them. The fs scope adds ColorSlots.User.xml in any folder, which the app reads beside an opened profile (specs/armor-preview.md item 11).
